notes: Only items with a check_key are hard constraints. Everything else is advisory.

items.do: Reject trivial one-step edits and settled best-practice questions.
Declare EXECUTE / EXECUTE+NET / REASONING-ONLY / no-subagents from harness-injected capabilities, never by guessing.
Never python -c a weaker rewrite of packaged scripts.
On interest-heavy problems write wall.json with ≥2 named persons and four load classes.
Standard concurrent sub-agents ≤ 4; Full ≤ 8. voices ≠ agents.
max_refs is an upper bound, not a quota. Priority: facilitation > role-generation > retrieval.
Unverified claims tagged prior-only — unverified. Same-model agreement is not evidence.
Never simulate the Approver. High-risk domains stay blocker until named human expert.
Adversary, reality wall, paradigm outsider are never optional.
Closed facilitation menu; no invented 12-phase process.
Fail-closed review is a fresh call on the artifact, not same-context self-audit.
